How online ticketing works

Ticketing is a supporting feature for selected events: three steps from browsing to a reservation.

1. Choose an eventBrowse upcoming events and open the one you want.
2. Check the detailsReview the date, time, location and activities.
3. Reserve ticketsSelect the number of tickets and enter a name for the booking.
